name: module-size-signal
body: The indicative size of a first-party source file — roughly 400 lines of production code — used as a SIGNAL for decomposition review, never as a target. A file above the signal is a prompt to inspect whether its responsibilities are cohesive and whether it should be split; the number itself is not an acceptance threshold, and a change that splits a file to fall under it without improving cohesion is a violation of the decomposition law. Test code is accounted separately and does not count against the signal.
